scope: Four identity-audit catalogue fields directly read alongside English/current isiZulu catalogue anchors. No live resource/map changes. Proper/technical name identity is assessed semantically, not mechanically called untranslated.

records.reason: This is an inventory of four internationally named instruments, not an untranslated English teaching sentence. Each loan name identifies a distinct catalogue instrument; inventing opaque isiZulu replacements or removing members would impair recognition.
records.context: Instrument/tuning catalogue name or instrument photo accessibility caption

records.reason: Ukulele and soprano/concert/tenor are established product/type labels for the ukulele family. The entire field is the instrument name plus variant nomenclature; retention is defensible under the catalogue loan-name policy, not proof of a missed prose translation.
records.context: Instrument/tuning catalogue name or instrument photo accessibility caption

records.reason: Trichordo is the named Greek bouzouki tuning/type, and D A D is literal pitch notation. The whole label is technical naming/notation with no ordinary English sentence to translate.
records.context: Instrument/tuning catalogue name or instrument photo accessibility caption

records.reason: The identity audit alone cannot prove an omission because alto/saxophone/E-flat are technical names. However, this photo-caption phrase can use the same localized isiZulu noun-class/possessive construction as the adjacent reviewed I-tenor saxophone ye-B-flat and I-clarinet ye-B-flat. The proposed I-alto saxophone ye-E-flat preserves the complete instrument/register/transposition identity while making catalogue syntax consistent.
records.context: Instrument/tuning catalogue name or instrument photo accessibility caption

family_label_scope_note: The existing family labels were inspected as anchors. No universal family-label/native approval is asserted and no speculative replacements are proposed for the source's elliptical Mallet, percussion & hand grouping.
